_comment: F38-F41 visual catalog plan (owner 12 Oct: separate tab and plan, most work to Codex, done last). Same axis as plan.json: a sprint is one 8-hour session from `start`. Codex lanes start when the Codex service bars in plan.json end; Claude lanes start when the main lanes end. Bars are sized at ~3 open catalog items per lane per sprint. `features` may name criteria ("F38#0"), a biome's catalog tasks ("VC:<biome>:<owner prefix>:<group>") or an owner's tasks across biomes once each ("VCU:<owner prefix>").
rebaselines: 2026-10-12 9:05 PM CDT (owner: F38-F41 become their own features with their 20+ catalog tasks each, a separate tab and plan, most work to Codex): first baseline. Four Codex biome lanes (re-score, top-20, impact >12, matrix and defect scan) and two Claude lanes for the cross-biome UI and pose rows.

2026-10-13 12:55 PM CDT (owner: 'Have Codex start that work with Astra in its own lanes ... let it do Meshy work where necessary'): the four Codex biome lanes start now (moved about 2 sprints earlier), run by Astra on tb/codex-look-<biome>. Each opens with a per-biome look pass (lighting rig, colour grade, material set) before its catalog rows, with Meshy hero assets where the judge says the scene can't close a gap. Scoring revised: three averaged judges, fixed camera sets, Bar A gate 8.5, two flat rounds to stop. The parked F08#3, F13#5, T2 current read and M3 visual bar fold into these lanes. Claude lanes unchanged.
